name: Colorable
summary: Web tool for testing a text and background colour pair against WCAG contrast ratios.
description: A single-page contrast checker: set the text and background colours with hue, saturation and lightness controls, and it shows a live sample with the contrast ratio and its WCAG grade (e.g. AAA). Includes an explanation of what contrast is and a Josef Albers quote.
contains: text and background colour controls (hue, saturation, lightness)
live contrast ratio with WCAG grade (e.g. AAA)
explanation of contrast and a Josef Albers quote
